assumptions.statement: The current SITE_BOUNDARY is a text-aligned provisional constraint derived from official written extents, approximate task scale, and open road-position background data; no trusted official polygon has been obtained.
assumptions.impact: It may support Chapter 02 research, design reasoning, visualization, topology checks, and current geometry recalculation, but not official redline, parcel, ownership, statutory-control, approval, surveying, engineering, or implementation claims.
assumptions.trigger: Replace only when an organizer-issued or otherwise cleared official polygon includes publisher, date, version, license, and CRS information.
assumptions.recalculation_scope: Regenerate dependent geometry, metrics, matrices, figures, A3/A0, offline HTML, and affected Chinese/English narrative from the same official polygon.

assumptions.statement: The three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional position-index placeholders calibrated to the official names, north-to-south order, and approximate announced areas; the announcement does not provide closed extents.
assumptions.impact: They may support location indexing and conceptual design only; their rectangular edges must not be read as parcel, road-redline, ownership, approval, or implementation boundaries.
assumptions.trigger: Replace when cleared official polygons for all three key areas are available and pass containment and non-overlap checks.
assumptions.recalculation_scope: Recalculate each key-area area, total area, containment, non-overlap, detailed-design layers, figures, metrics, matrices, and narrative.

assumptions.statement: Land-use contains the 556 frozen Figure 7-1 function-role polygons plus four residual partitions; Chapter 08 roads now contain nine low-confidence concept mobility features clipped to the live provisional boundary; official constraint geometry remains unavailable, while green/public-space layers retain minimum-viable design geometry.
assumptions.impact: Land-use, green/public-space and Chapter 08 concept-network values are reproducible design-model outputs, but none may be represented as statutory controls, official road mileage, engineering alignments or implementation quantities.
assumptions.trigger: Replace each provisional or participant-derived layer when organizer-cleared official geometry and professional system data become available.
assumptions.recalculation_scope: Regenerate affected geometry and metrics, then synchronize matrices, figures, bilingual reports, A3/A0 and offline HTML.

assumptions.statement: The Chapter 07 topology preserves the exact geometry of all 556 function-role polygons displayed in frozen Figure 7-1 and uses four non-rendered residual partitions to close the live provisional SITE-001; it is not derived from organizer-issued parcel plans or approved control drawings.
assumptions.impact: Areas and shares for the submitted land-use code subset are finite and reproducible for proposal comparison, and the figure-to-GeoJSON geometry hash is auditable; they cannot support statutory land-use balance, ownership, development approval or parcel-level implementation conclusions.
assumptions.trigger: Replace when organizer-cleared parcel geometry or approved control drawings cover the full design area and provide source, version, date, CRS and usage rights.
assumptions.recalculation_scope: Regenerate land_use.geojson, recalculate the Chapter 07 balance and dependent metrics, and synchronize proposal, matrices, figures, bilingual reports, A3/A0 and offline HTML.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The current package uses provisional scope geometry and may be reviewed only as a concept and evidence-governed working submission; statutory controls and professional implementation conclusions remain pending official data and professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Chapter 05 existing-capacity ranges are calculated from provisional key-area polygons and GABLE satellite-derived building footprints and heights, using 3.3-4.2 m as an equivalent floor-height range.
assumptions.impact: The ranges support comparison of existing spatial carrying capacity and renewal emphasis only. They are not surveyed gross floor area, statutory FAR, approved height, parcel ownership, demolition permission, new-build capacity or investment commitment.
assumptions.trigger: Replace when official key-area polygons, approved planning controls, parcel-level current-condition survey and verified building floor-area records are available.
assumptions.recalculation_scope: Recompute Chapter 05 scale tables, retain-renovate-demolish quantities, metrics, figures, bilingual reports, A3/A0 and Chapter 10 project interfaces.

assumptions.statement: Green-space geometry combines dated EULUC/control-plan-draft open-space roles with a 35 m half-width Jingzhang-axis interface band; public-space geometry combines a 25 m half-width axis interface band, 55 m buffers around the 29 conceptual crossing anchors inverse-mapped from the canonical site-overview calibration, and three Chapter 05 key-area implementation-node envelopes.
assumptions.impact: The resulting 13.505068% green-space coverage and 4.368577% public-space coverage are finite, reproducible low-confidence design-model ratios only. They are not statutory green-space ratio, public ownership ratio, parcel/redline, approval, survey or engineering conclusions.
assumptions.trigger: Replace when organizer-issued official boundary and control layers, surveyed public-space ownership, and detailed-design green/public-space polygons become available.
assumptions.recalculation_scope: Regenerate green_space.geojson and public_space.geojson, recalculate areas and ratios, and synchronize affected narrative, matrices, figures, bilingual reports, A3/A0 and offline HTML.

assumptions.statement: Chapter 08 roads comprise nine participant concept features derived from dated local OSM references and the Jingzhang background proxy, clipped to the provisional SITE-001 boundary.
assumptions.impact: They support network relationships, figure traceability and reproducible concept length only; they are not official road redlines, rail or station geometry, traffic engineering, bridge/tunnel schemes or implementation commitments.
assumptions.trigger: Replace after official road/rail/station data, field verification and professional traffic/municipal review are available.
assumptions.recalculation_scope: Regenerate roads and affected constraints, recalculate metrics, and synchronize proposal, matrices, figures, bilingual reports, A3/A0 and offline HTML.

assumptions.statement: Chapter 11 sets participant scenario thresholds for active AI-enterprise aggregation, AI-talent spatial density and site-attributable AI-industry output as indices relative to a future verified T0 baseline: near-term 110/108/115, mid-term 125/120/140 and long-term 140/130/170, with T0=100.
assumptions.impact: The indices make the competition proposal's objectives auditable without fabricating current site totals. They are design-performance thresholds for scenario comparison, not official forecasts, government KPIs, investment-attraction commitments, or verified present values.
assumptions.trigger: Establish E0, D0 and V0 from one boundary, reference date, enterprise activity register, deduplicated talent register and site-attributable output ledger; then convert the indices into absolute targets and review them against spatial, transport, municipal, housing, public-service, green-space and governance capacity.
assumptions.recalculation_scope: Update the three current-value metrics and the three target metrics, then synchronize Chapter 11, compliance evidence, metrics-evidence figures, bilingual reports, A3/A0 and offline HTML.

assumptions.statement: Chapter 05 uses provisional key-area polygons, GABLE VHR building proxies, Chapter 04 renewal readings, and transparent project-envelope ratios to form scheme-level capacity bands and building-object renewal classifications.
assumptions.impact: The outputs close the competition's design-expression requirement at conceptual urban-design depth, but they are not statutory FAR, surveyed floor area, ownership, approved construction quantity, engineering alignment, or confirmed demolition decisions.
assumptions.trigger: Replace and recompute after official key-area polygons, parcel/building survey, ownership, planning controls, heritage controls, traffic and engineering conditions are supplied.
assumptions.recalculation_scope: Regenerate Chapter 05 building objects, project envelopes, incremental-capacity bands, node controls, metrics, matrices, figures, and narrative.
